name: Reverse Engineering & Binary Inspection
status: Operative Form: Structural Binary Deconstruction & Protocol Evidence
orientation: Deconstruct binary artifacts, compiled assemblies, protocol contracts, and application boundaries into inspectable, falsifiable structural evidence. Treat software as an inspectable lattice of physical bytes, schemas, and control boundaries.

static_decomposition.focus: Perception of binary layouts: PE/.NET metadata streams (#Strings, #US, #Blob), section headers, and exported types.
static_decomposition.law: Physical byte reality precedes hypothesis. Symbols and offsets are facts; architectural roles are inferences.

tomoe.1: Observation: extract headers, architectures, sections, and metadata streams directly from binary bytes.
tomoe.2: Armament / Load-Bearing: map extracted symbols, RPC interfaces, and data schemas against claimed operational interfaces.
tomoe.3: Conquerors / Situating: evaluate binary dependencies, security mitigations, and execution boundaries before interaction.

boundary_mapping.focus: Identification of interaction planes: OS accessibility hooks (UIA/IA2), IPC pipes, WebView bridges, and RPC endpoints.

tomoe.1: First-order access: trace raw socket, pipe, and event-hook bindings.
tomoe.2: Second-order access: map client-server synchronization, delta updates, and serialization formats.
tomoe.3: Third-order access: determine isolation boundaries (contextIsolation, sandboxes, permission gates).

protocol_reconstruction.focus: Reconstructing structured contracts (Protobuf, JSON-RPC, Quill Deltas, Diff-Match-Patch) from ground bytes.

tomoe.1: Extract contract structures, field descriptors, and serialization boundaries.
tomoe.2: Correlate client request messages with expected server response schemas.

wielding_rules: Direct Carrier Contact: Inspect physical binary bytes, section headers, and metadata directly before asserting execution or capability.
Epistemic Partitioning: Explicitly distinguish observed symbol/metadata tokens from semantic behavioral hypotheses.
Reversibility Matrix: Read-only static inspection proceeds autonomously in Tier 0; dynamic instrumentation or execution mutation requires explicit gating.
Attribution Conservation: Wielding external reverse engineering tools does not make target capabilities intrinsic without structural integration.
Null Legitimacy: An inspection encounter that reveals zero vulnerabilities or confirms unyielding encapsulation is a legitimate terminal verdict.

conduit_contract.carrier_contact: Inspect physical bytes, strings, and headers via tools/reverse_engineer.py or REA.
conduit_contract.epistemic_partitioning: Label raw extracted symbols as OBSERVED and architectural models as INFERRED.
conduit_contract.field_operation: Produce verifiable structural reports linking claims to exact offsets and byte signatures.
